name: McDonald's
source_title: McDonald's UK product pages: Nutritional Information (per portion) and Ingredients & Allergens (read 2026-10-09, no date shown)
sites_evidence: https://www.mcdonalds.com/gb/en-gb/newsroom.html says 'more than 1,600 restaurants across the UK and Ireland' (no UK-only count is shown on the site)
note: Figures are per portion as printed on each product page; the page says some exclude optional condiments (Chicken Selects, McNuggets, Side Salad, Pancakes). Menu and availability can differ by restaurant. Meal, Happy Meal and Meal Deal pages were not read. Allergens are the words the page marks in bold in each product's Ingredients & Allergens panel; 'may contain' comes from the N.B. lines in that panel. Products whose panel lists no ingredients at all have no allergen entry.
